team.title: Meet the team
team.intro: Each agent has one job and does it all day. You only talk to the manager.

members.name: Manager
members.role: You talk to it in one chat. It understands your request, gives it to the right agent, reviews the work and comes back with the result.

members.name: Customer service
members.role: Answers your customers on WhatsApp, Messenger, site chat and Facebook comments, from what it knows about your business. When it doesn't know, it passes the conversation to you.
members.spares: Answering "how much?" in the middle of the night.

members.name: Order confirmation
members.role: Sends every new order a WhatsApp message with a confirm button and a cancel button, and tells you who confirmed and who canceled.

members.name: Content
members.role: Plans your posts, writes them, prepares their images, and publishes or schedules them on your Facebook Page.
members.spares: A quiet Page because there's no time to write.

members.name: Knowledge
members.role: Learns your business from your website, your files and your customers' questions, and the rest of the team answers from it.
members.spares: Repeating the same information every time.

members.name: Reports
members.role: Tells you how many conversations were answered, what is waiting for you, and the average reply time.
members.spares: Digging through screens to see how work is going.

members.name: A custom agent
members.role: Need an agent for a job that isn't on the list? Hire a custom one, tell it its job, and the manager adds it to the team.
members.spares: The recurring job nobody has time for.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: All plans are in Egyptian pounds. Start free, and grow the team as your business grows.
pricing.metaFees: WhatsApp fees aren't part of the plan price. You pay them to Meta directly, with no markup from Wkil: on order confirmation messages, and on WhatsApp replies after the first 1,000 messages a month per number. Messenger and site chat carry no Meta fees.
notes: All numbers are monthly. A conversation is one customer over 24 hours, however many messages they send.
Pay yearly and get 2 months free, with your price fixed for 12 months.

trial.text: Growth free for 14 days, up to 300 order confirmations. Meta's message fees are yours, and afterwards you pick your plan or stay on Free.

accordions.question: Outgrown your plan?
accordions.answer: An extra conversation is EGP 1 and an extra order confirmation is EGP 0.50. There are cheaper usage packs for Growth and Scale.

accordions.question: Another WhatsApp number?
accordions.answer: Add one for EGP 299 a month on Growth or Scale.

accordions.question: An agency, more than 3 numbers, or more than 5,000 orders a month?
accordions.answer: A custom plan starts at EGP 7,999 a month, invoiced by bank transfer.

items.question: Does the team work on its own?
items.answer: Yes. Customer replies and order confirmation run all day with nothing for you to do. When you ask the manager to publish a post or send a message in your name, it shows you what it will do first.

items.question: What if an agent can't answer a customer?
items.answer: It stops, and the conversation moves to your inbox with its type: sales, support or complaint. You can reply yourself in any conversation.

items.question: Does the team work on Instagram?
items.answer: No. The team works on WhatsApp, Messenger, site chat and Facebook comments, and publishes to Facebook Pages.

items.question: Can my number stay on the WhatsApp Business app?
items.answer: Yes, if you like. The number stays on the app and the team replies alongside you, or you can use a dedicated number.

items.question: My store isn't on EasyOrders?
items.answer: If your store can send orders to a webhook, you can connect it. If your system has an API, the team can look up a price or an order status from it on the Growth plan. Both need a technical person.
